model: residual = strength * Delta, Delta = CLAHE of the neutral log2 luminance minus itself, optionally smoothed
score: share of the variance of Lightroom's change of log2 luminance left unexplained, leave-one-scene-out, before (IPR band model) and after the CLAHE term
range: 0.5 to 99.5 % of the valid log2 luminance
